summary: Hackers compromised an employee email account at marketing firm Appier, which had once sent promotional emails for CJ ENM's closed Funshop shopping mall. The attacker used two Funshop customer distribution lists left in the account to send over 30,000 Netflix-impersonating phishing emails to Funshop customers from June 19. Appier did not notice until a media inquiry, and CJ ENM reported it to Korea's privacy commission.
